data.description: Stunning Penthouses & Apartments for Sale at Bayz 102, Business Bay
data.long_description:
Bayz 102 is a 102-storey state-of-the-art residential tower developed by Danube Properties, offering an exceptional fusion of modern design and luxury living in the heart of Business Bay.

The building’s sleek, innovative façade stands as a bold addition to Dubai's iconic skyline, epitomizing both elegance and sophistication. Bayz 102 offers a diverse range of living spaces, including studios, 1- to 4-bedroom apartments, and expansive 5-bedroom penthouses.

Each residence is adorned with premium Italian furnishings, decorative kitchen panels, and exquisite Black Marquina marble finishes. Gold and pearl white accents elevate the overall design, while the convertible kitchen harmoniously combines functionality and style, making it the centerpiece of each home.

Bayz 102 residents can enjoy a wide array of world-class amenities, including an indoor gym, aquatic gym, business center, library, children's play area, BBQ zone, and a dedicated salon. These facilities are meticulously designed to meet the needs of both individuals and families.

Strategically located in Business Bay, Bayz 102 is just one minute from the metro station, offering residents easy access to many of Dubai's landmark destinations. Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the Museum of the Future are only 2 to 5 minutes away, while Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and Dubai International Airport are just 20 minutes away.

Contact Provident Real Estate today to schedule a viewing or for more information.
